title: dataset_card
description: EchoForge dataset_card document. Declares a named dataset assembled from one or more source RCS campaigns, with train/validation/test split counts. Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic ids, explicit provenance, license, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1, computed from the identity field tuple.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator; must be the literal string "dataset_card".

schema_version.description: Schema contract version this document conforms to (currently pinned to 1.0.0).

public_proxy_id.description: Slug identifying the public proxy this dataset is derived from (lowercase, dot/underscore/hyphen separated).

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: source kind, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) governing use of this document.

validation.description: Validation envelope: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and per-check results.

dataset_name.description: Human-readable name of the dataset (e.g. "xband_vehicles_v1"); non-empty string.

source_campaign_ids.description: Deterministic ids of the rcs_campaign documents that contributed samples to this dataset; at least one entry required.

splits.description: Sample counts per dataset split (train / validation / test); each count is a non-negative integer (number of samples).

train.description: Number of samples in the training split; non-negative integer.

validation.description: Number of samples in the validation split; non-negative integer.

test.description: Number of samples in the test split; non-negative integer.
